headline: Community forum on draft ASTE educational specifications for the proposed one new Wallingford High School.
summary: The Board of Education will hold a community forum to discuss draft ASTE educational specifications for the proposed new Wallingford High School. Public comment will be taken after the discussion.
items: Discussion of draft ASTE educational specifications for the proposed one new Wallingford High School
location: ASTE Community Room, Lyman Hall High School
